attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Iowa state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per Iowa Code § 422.5: tax = max(AGI - $0 std ded, 0) x 3.8%. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Iowa Tax Calculation (top marginal 3.8%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 0.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.038 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " IA taxable income (AGI - $0): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " IA state tax (top marginal 3.8%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: IA: 3.8% x max(AGI - $0, 0) per Iowa Code § 422.5
